title: 写作模拟测试
goal: 判断任务覆盖、段落支撑和句子完整性。

points.label: 判断短文是否覆盖写作要求
选择支持中心论点的内容
识别并修正不完整的句子

sources.title: C2 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
大学英语四级（CET-4）：课表
sources.used: 写作模拟测试的知识点和教学规格

body.p: 完整的作文在短文写作练习中完成：按提示写 1 篇英语短文，不少于 120 词，限时 30 分钟。任务数量和时间依据 C1 CET笔试，字数要求依据 C2 大纲。
本课的客观题检查三项：任务覆盖、段落支撑、句子完整。客观题的成绩不代表作文成绩。

groups.text:
Writing task: Explain one benefit of a shared tool library and suggest one way to encourage residents to use it.

Draft: A shared tool library saves residents from buying equipment they need only occasionally. For example, neighbors can borrow a ladder for a single repair instead of purchasing one.

items.stem: Which required element is missing from the draft?
options: An example of an occasional repair
items.why: 题目要求 suggest one way to encourage residents to use it。草稿只写了好处和借梯子的例子，缺这一项，即第二项。

items.stem: Which sentence best completes the missing requirement?
options: Residents sometimes need a ladder for only one repair in the whole year.
A shared library can reduce the number of tools each household buys.
The library could display borrowing instructions at the community center.
A ladder is one kind of equipment that residents may borrow from the library.
items.why: 第三项的 display borrowing instructions 是鼓励居民使用的办法。其余各项只重复了已有的好处或例子。

items.stem: Which sentence best supports the claim that sharing tools reduces purchases?
options: A resident can borrow a drill for one task instead of buying one.
A resident can read the library's opening hours before visiting.
The library can display borrowing instructions near its entrance.
The library can label each shelf with the names of its tools.
items.why: 第一项写借电钻做一件事，不用买，直接支持减少购买的论点。

items.stem: The missing requirement is to ___ one way to encourage residents to use the library. Complete with the exact verb from the task.
items.why: 题目用的动词是 suggest，草稿还没有给出办法。

groups.text:
Writing task: Explain why a student group should keep records of its decisions and give an example.

Claim: Written records help members remember what was agreed.

Draft fragment: Because the secretary recorded the meeting's decisions.

items.stem: Which example most directly supports the claim?
options: The members discussed a date before the secretary recorded their decision.
The secretary recorded the meeting decisions without adding an example.
The members selected a date without consulting the meeting record.
A member checked the notes later to confirm the date everyone had chosen.
items.why: 第四项写成员事后查笔记确认日期，说明记录帮助成员回忆决定。第一项只写了记录的过程。

items.stem: Complete a supporting sentence showing how records help members recall a decision.
items.why: 不定式 to confirm 表示查笔记的目的。confirming to 不成立。

items.stem: Complete the sentence with the missing past-tense form of be: The notes ___ useful to the group.
items.why: notes 是复数，be 的过去式用 were。

items.stem: The fragment needs a main clause. Complete the sentence using the given words.
items.lead: Because the secretary recorded the decisions, the members
items.why: Because 从句后接主句 the members could check。could 后用动词原形。
